text: First Pacific parametric micro‑insurance product with VAT-exempt premiums and government-subsidized coverage for social welfare recipients. The initiative features rapid digital payouts, community co‑creation, and intentional gender and disability inclusion. It is integrated with Fiji's national financial inclusion strategy and involves South‑South learning with India. The framework is part of a larger national strategy linked to the InsuResilience Global Partnership action agenda.
